title: Retain edited configuration during an RPM upgrade
goal: Practice %config(noreplace), installed version and actual .rpmnew/.rpmsave behavior.
challenge: Starting from data 1.0-1, preserve the original and set header=owner-kept in only its declared configuration. Upgrade to data 2.0-1 without replacing that local value. Retain and inspect .rpmnew, verify actual package contents/version and deliberate config discrepancy, then clean up with candidates preserved first.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-upgrade.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-upgrade.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" preview data1 && sudo "$h" apply data1

here && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf original.conf && cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && printf "%s\n" header=owner-kept | sudo tee /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf >/dev/null && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf edited.conf && sudo "$h" preview upgrade
steps.explanation: Preserve original before changing only this declared config. Guard its type, ownership, mode, links and parent.
steps.expected: Preserved original and edit; exact upgrade plan.

steps.explanation: Confirm the exact upgrade. %config(noreplace) behavior is package-specific, not universal RPM policy.
steps.expected: Data 2.0; edit retained and a .rpmnew candidate.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && cmp edited.conf /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew candidate.conf && grep -Fx header=inventory-2.0 candidate.conf && fresh "$w/verification.txt" || return 19; if rpm -V ll-rpm-data > verification.txt; then return 1; else rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1 && grep -F /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf verification.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: Retain and inspect old/edit/new versions. Verification should report the deliberate configuration difference; earlier guard failure must not be accepted as rpm evidence.
steps.expected: Actual config discrepancy, independent copies and upgraded payload.

hints: Do not assume Debian conffile semantics or silently overwrite user content; skipped/different-version transactions are not upgrades.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 upgrade/reinstall lifecycle. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
